title: Run the Stripe catalog sync for the ladder: test mode, then live after the owner says yes
detail: PHASE 1 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. After LIVE-747 merges, sync the catalog in Stripe test mode, check collective_base, collective_space and nonprofit_collective products and prices, then live mode on the owner's explicit yes. Old Collective Stripe items must still reconcile.

verify.evidence: Open until pricing_stripe_prices in production holds collective_base_month/_year, collective_space_month/_year and nonprofit_collective_month/_year rows with live price ids, read by SQL after the live sync.
